verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches team collaboration at a surface level: support-site headings mention emailing team members and recruiters in one place and organizing the recruiting team. The webhook docs show hiring roles with assignable abilities, which implies role-based permissions but does not show them scoping feedback. Missing for 10: any evidence of @mentions, shared candidate notes, task assignment, or visibility rules restricting sensitive feedback, plus in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of collaboration features.
